Upload in three steps, for clients that send the file to storage themselves: (1) this call returns a 15-minute signed PUT URL for a server-chosen path in the integration’s upload folder; (2) PUT the file to `uploadUrl` with header `Content-Type: <contentType>`; (3) call `POST /csv/uploads/register` with `filePath`. Size is checked at register (`maxBytes`).
